blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several prosecutors may have said that the end is near for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, but this does not mean there will be fewer battles and tense moments, with the defense panel starting to present witnesses meant to demolish the prosecution’s arguments. The defense panel submitted documents to the Senate Impeachment Court showing that it would call around 25 witnesses to counter Article II of the Articles of Impeachment, which accuses Duterte of amassing unexplained wealth and failing to properly disclose her assets in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).
